name: GCP Cloud Functions
description: Pull GCP Cloud Functions as serverless cloud workloads for CNAPP inventory and posture analysis

steps.instruction: Open GCP Console → IAM & Admin → Service Accounts
Create a new service account (or select an existing one) and grant the 'Cloud Functions Viewer' role
Click the service account → Keys → Add Key → Create new key → JSON, then open the downloaded file
Copy the value of 'private_key' (the full PEM block including headers)

validation_request.error_message: Could not connect to GCP Cloud Functions. Verify the service account has the Cloud Functions Viewer role on the project.

transform.expr: {'cloud_provider': 'gcp', 'service': 'cloud_functions', 'function_name': (str(record.get('name', '')).split('/')[-1] if record.get('name') else ''), 'resource_name': record.get('name', ''), 'project_id': (str(record.get('name', '')).split('/')[1] if record.get('name') and len(str(record.get('name', '')).split('/')) > 1 else ''), 'region': (str(record.get('name', '')).split('/')[3] if record.get('name') and len(str(record.get('name', '')).split('/')) > 3 else ''), 'display_name': (str(record.get('name', '')).split('/')[-1] if record.get('name') else '')}

{'cloud_provider': 'gcp', 'resource_type': 'cloud_function', 'environment': record.get('environment', ''), 'state': record.get('state', ''), 'description': record.get('description', ''), 'runtime': (record.get('buildConfig', {}) or {}).get('runtime', ''), 'entry_point': (record.get('buildConfig', {}) or {}).get('entryPoint', ''), 'service_account_email': (record.get('serviceConfig', {}) or {}).get('serviceAccountEmail', ''), 'available_memory': (record.get('serviceConfig', {}) or {}).get('availableMemory', ''), 'timeout_seconds': (record.get('serviceConfig', {}) or {}).get('timeoutSeconds', 0), 'max_instance_count': (record.get('serviceConfig', {}) or {}).get('maxInstanceCount', 0), 'ingress_settings': (record.get('serviceConfig', {}) or {}).get('ingressSettings', ''), 'uri': (record.get('serviceConfig', {}) or {}).get('uri', ''), 'environment_variables': list(((record.get('serviceConfig', {}) or {}).get('environmentVariables', {}) or {}).keys()), 'labels': record.get('labels', {}), 'update_time': record.get('updateTime', '')}
